articles.headline: Eliminating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference with Integer-Only Arithmetic
articles.blurb: A floating-point number stores a fixed number of significant digits and a separate exponent. When two numbers with very different exponents are added, the small one has to be shifted to line up with the big one, and the digits that fall off on the end are gone. That means that (a+b)+c is not always equal to a+(b+c). This post looks at what happens when integer addition, which is exact, is used.

Red Hat says public research shows a reliable exploit, while Wiz reports that no exploit is available and no attacks have been seen. Admins should upgrade to 2.4.71, or their distribution's patched package, such as RHEL 9's mod_http2-2.0.26-7.el9_9.1, or else remove h2 and h2c from every Protocols directive, which is the only option for the archived standalone mod_h2 builds.

articles.headline: ARTEX and AI-Powered Red Teaming Tools: What Defenders Need to Know

The agents validated more than 200 client secrets in about three minutes and attacked in bursts of 1 to 14 requests followed by 25 to 31 second pauses while waiting on the model. Unit 42 counted 609 internet-facing ARTEX hosts and 1,323 running CyberStrikeAI, and noted that the tooling is forked so often that behavioral hunting holds up better than IOCs. articles.headline: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2

The client then connects outbound to GSocket's public relay network, which pairs it with the operator using only a shared secret, so there is no attacker IP or domain to block. Microsoft saw GSocket detections rise 356% between March and August across multiple unrelated actors, some of whom also tried the Dirty Frag kernel exploit (CVE-2026-43284) to gain root access. Defenders should treat a patched web app as only half the fix: remove the GSocket client and every layer of its persistence, apply deny-by-default egress rules that block the relay, and mount /dev/shm and temp directories as noexec.

The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia.
